description: Two voltage-controlled amplifiers that either run as separate channels or feed a constant-power panner

params.text: Attenuates the left channel, 0% to 100%; in pan mode it sets the level of the mixed signal feeding OUT L.
Attenuates the right channel, 0% to 100%; in pan mode it sets the level of the mixed signal feeding OUT R.
Places the mixed signal across OUT L and OUT R on a constant-power curve, hard left at -1 and hard right at +1.
Chooses whether that channel's CV input acts linearly or exponentially, leaving the knob's own response untouched.
Chooses between two independent amplifiers and a panner fed by both inputs mixed together.

inputs.text: The left input; in pan mode it is mixed with the right input before the panner.
The right input; in pan mode it is mixed with the left input before the panner.
Scales the left channel, silent at 0V and full at 10V; with nothing patched here the channel stays at its knob setting.
Scales the right channel, silent at 0V and full at 10V; with nothing patched here the channel stays at its knob setting.
Shifts the pan position of the mixed signal.

outputs.text: The left channel after its attenuator, or the left side of the pan.
The right channel after its attenuator, or the right side of the pan.
The two attenuated channels added together.
The two attenuated channels added together and then subtracted from 1V, despite the panel printing SUM- and the manual calling it their difference.

inputs.3:
0 to 10V · continuous · one channel only

a negative voltage does nothing here.
